transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I came in because... well, I'm having trouble at work. I'm a supervisor in retail, so I have to explain things like inventory numbers and the weekend schedule to my team. But lately, when I try to do that, my words just... they start jumping around. I'll be talking about delivery trucks, and then suddenly I'm talking about Thursdays, and then the church grill, and then how my boss sounded on the phone. People just look at me. I can tell they have no idea what I'm trying to say, and I can't seem to keep my thoughts straight enough to explain it right.
Have you been feeling unusually high, euphoric, or overly energized lately?

No, not at all. I haven't felt unusually high or energized. Honestly, I'm mostly just frustrated with... well, with not being able to communicate right at work. But no, I haven't had any extra energy or anything like that.
Have you been hearing voices when no one else is around?

No, I haven't heard any voices. Nothing like that. It's really just the trouble I mentioned with my thoughts getting all jumbled up when I try to speak, but... no, I don't hear anyone talking when I'm by myself.
Have you been feeling like someone is trying to harm you or plot against you?

No, I haven't felt anything like that. I don't think anyone's out to get me or plotting behind my back. Like I said, the main issue is just... my head gets so mixed up when I'm trying to explain things to my team. But no, I don't feel like I'm in danger or being targeted.
Have you found yourself feeling emotionally flat or not reacting much to things lately?

No, I don't think so. I still feel things the way I normally do. I mean, I definitely get frustrated when I can't get my point across to my staff at the store... but no, I wouldn't say I feel flat or numb or anything like that. I react to things just fine.
Did this problem with your thoughts and speech start very suddenly?

Well, I'm not exactly sure, to be honest. I don't think it was just... one day I was fine and the next I couldn't talk right. It's hard to put a finger on exactly when it began. I just know it's been happening a lot lately when I try to run the shift and talk to my team. So, no, I wouldn't say it was a sudden thing, I just sort of realized it was becoming a real problem.
Have other people told you that your behavior seems very disorganized or odd lately?

Well, nobody has come right out and used the word 'odd,' but... I know they've noticed some things. Like, sometimes out on the sales floor, I'll catch myself just pacing the exact same aisle. I'll be straightening the same row of batteries over and over again. Or I'll just be standing there with the schedule clipboard in my hand, and the associates are all just looking at me, waiting for me to tell them what to do. So, yeah, I guess my behavior has been a bit disorganized at work.
Have there been times when your body gets stuck in one position or you stop moving and don't respond to people?

No, I haven't noticed anything like that. I mean, I might stand in one spot for a bit when I'm distracted by the schedule, like I mentioned before, but my body doesn't actually get stuck. I can always move just fine. And if an associate asks me a question, I hear them and try to respond... I don't just freeze up or stop reacting to people. So, no, I haven't had that happen.
Have you had any fixed beliefs that other people would find strange or hard to believe?

No, I don't think so. I haven't had any strange beliefs like that. I just go to work, try to manage my team... I don't have any unusual ideas or anything that people would find hard to believe. It's just the trouble with my thoughts getting jumbled up, mostly. But no weird beliefs, no.
Have you been having trouble taking care of your usual daily responsibilities lately?

Yeah, I have. It's... it's been tough lately. At work, they actually pulled me off the busy weekend shifts because I'm just not trusted to run them right now. My boss sat me down for a performance review recently and flat out warned me that I could be suspended if things don't turn around. 

And it's bleeding into my personal life, too. My wife has had to step in and cover a lot of the commitments I used to handle... mostly because people were starting to get uncomfortable or just confused around me when I tried to do them. So, yeah, I'm definitely struggling to keep up with my usual responsibilities.
Have you had any beliefs that other people would say are clearly false or bizarre?

No, I think... well, like I said just a minute ago, I don't really have any strange ideas like that. I know my thoughts get jumbled up, and obviously I'm struggling to keep up at work, but I don't believe things that are completely false or... bizarre. I just see things the way they are. Nobody has ever told me I'm believing things that are completely made up, no.
Have you been talking much less than you used to lately?

No, I wouldn't say that. I mean, I still talk to my wife just as much, and I obviously have to talk to the staff at the store, even if they've cut back my shifts. I haven't really noticed myself being any quieter than usual. I just talk when I need to, pretty much the same as always.
Have you found yourself having much less motivation to start or keep up with everyday tasks?

No, not really. I mean, I still get up and do what I need to do. Like I said, work has been hard, and my wife is taking on more of the household stuff, but it's not because I don't want to do things or lack the drive. I still have the motivation to try... it's just that when I do try, things get confusing or people get uncomfortable. But the actual motivation to start tasks? No, that's still there.
Do people tell you that your facial expression or voice seems less expressive than it used to?

No, nobody's ever said anything like that to me. I don't think my face or my voice has changed. I mean, my wife hasn't mentioned anything about me looking blank or sounding flat, and the people at the store haven't brought it up either. I feel like I'm expressing myself the exact same way I always have.
When people say your speech is hard to follow, do they mean that your ideas seem disconnected or jump from one topic to another?

Yeah, that's exactly it. That's actually why I came in. When I'm at the store and I try to explain something... like the inventory numbers or the weekend schedule... my words just start jumping around. I'll be talking about the delivery trucks, and then suddenly I'm talking about Thursdays, and then the grill at church, and then how my boss sounded when he talked to me. People just look at me like they have no idea what I'm saying. They can't follow it at all.
